coordinate_definition: body_blocks and body_block_index are zero-based p/tbl block ordinals yielded by docx_text.iter_blocks(body), with block wrappers expanded and non-block bookmark nodes omitted. They are not raw w:body child ordinals. Paragraph_index and all_paragraph_index are separate paragraph-only ordinals.
coordinate_mapping_method: Same parsed element object identity, not serialized XML equality.

initial_mapping_failure_preserved.failure: Serialized XML keys collide for identical empty paragraphs; its full raw ordinal mapping is superseded by this same-object mapping.
